item.title: Durham spinout Quantia raises pre-seed round
item.content:encoded:
Quantia, a spinout from Durham University, has raised a pre-seed round.

The company is commercialising quantum sensing technology.

item.title: Newcastle University spin-out secures seed funding
item.content:encoded: A spin-out from Newcastle University has secured seed funding for its medical imaging platform.

item.title: Sunderland spinout wins Innovate UK grant
item.content:encoded: A spinout from the University of Sunderland has won an Innovate UK grant.

item.title: Applications open for the Executives into Business programme
item.content:encoded: Northern Accelerator has opened applications for its 2026 programme at Durham University, Newcastle University and Northumbria University.
